note: Warp destinations added by modules/places.js. pos is in map units (multiplied by the world scale, 3). kind picks the scenery builder. terr = [faction id or null, colour, label] for the galaxy map. ads = billboard images (modules/space_ads.js). locked places stay '??? UNKNOWN SIGNAL' until unlocked in play.

places.name: VEIL OUTPOST
places.l3: nebula survey post · fly the 3 buoys
places.blurb: A research ring inside the Veil nebula. Fly through the three survey buoys to sell them your sensor data.

places.name: KORVA ICE WORKS
places.l3: ice mining colony · buys ore · hull repair
places.blurb: A Ceres Co-op mining colony on a comet of old ice. They buy ore above the station rate and patch hulls for free.

places.name: THE SILENT GATE
places.blurb: A broken ring older than the colonies. Four pylons still carry glyphs. Fly close to each one to read it.

places.name: ASHFALL FIELD
places.blurb: Where the Compact and the Red Wake fought their largest battle. Salvage crates drift between the hulks. So do live mines.

places.name: BLACK ANCHOR
places.l3: pirate hideout · fence pays for data
places.blurb: A Red Wake hideout inside a hollow rock. Not on any chart. The fence pays for whatever your sensors logged on the way in.

places.name: TALOS IV
places.l3: second planet · orbit only for now
places.blurb: A banded desert world with a thin ring. You can hold orbit; landing sites are not charted yet.
